title: Recruited into the GTE program and combat control
place_text: US Air Force; Lackland Air Force Base, Texas

tellings.quote: Yeah, so I ended up getting recruited to a brand new program that was called GTE,

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot, tells Michels that in 1994 he was recruited into "a brand new program that was called GTE" in the US Air Force, which he does not spell out, and went through Lackland Air Force Base in Texas. He says this led him into combat control, the Air Force special troops who work on the ground directing aircraft. It is his own account of how his military career began.
